tests.why: 调度使用 float64，前向加噪保持输入的形状与 dtype。
离散时间的下标和 cosine 比值约定必须精确一致。
每步保留的信息都会减少，累计 alpha 与 log-SNR 严格下降。
原始 DDPM 的线性调度终端累计 alpha 约为 4e-5 而不是零。
cosine 的最后一步需要截断以免累计信号彻底消失。
关闭信号或噪声的一项后，闭式表达式只剩另一项。
一个 batch 的每行都有自己的时间索引。
独立单位高斯的线性组合，在系数平方和为一时仍有单位方差。
Attention supports distinct query/key/value dimensions without mutating inputs.
Two-key probability equals sigmoid of the scaled score difference.
Allowed-key mask broadcasts across heads; empty rows have finite zero gradients.
Jointly permuting keys and values or adding a common key shift leaves outputs unchanged.
Masked attention has the same q/k/v derivatives as an independently constructed softmax.
Changing future keys and values cannot influence a causal prefix.
Uniform causal scores compute exact prefix means and exclude changed future values.

prefix_averaging.provenance: PaperLeet teaching adaptation of Transformer Section 3.2.1

tests.why: Adapters use A[r,in], B[out,r]; arbitrary leading input dimensions are preserved.
Non-square matrices, non-unit alpha and bias agree with the reference.
The update has rank at most r and merged/unmerged linear maps are equivalent.
Base weights and bias stay frozen while input and both nonzero adapters receive exact gradients.
Zero B preserves the base output, initially giving zero A gradient but nonzero B gradient.
Adapter training recovers a known low-rank update and preserves merged inference equivalence.

provenance.adaptation: PaperLeet rank-two synthetic regression, not a language-model benchmark.

tests.why: Functional optimizer preserves tensor shape/dtype and leaves every input untouched.
At step one corrected moments are gradient and gradient squared, with eps outside sqrt.
Without gradient or history, decay scales every parameter equally and has a known Jacobian.
Changing weight decay alters parameters by lr*delta_decay*p and leaves optimizer state identical.
Multiple updates, nondefault betas and changing learning rates agree with torch.optim.AdamW.
Reordering parameter coordinates and all associated state simply reorders the result.
The submitted update optimizes a deterministic two-coordinate quadratic over 200 steps.

quadratic_optimization.provenance: PaperLeet teaching adaptation of AdamW Algorithm 2

tests.why: Preserve shape/dtype and reject unsupported layouts without modifying input.
Tall and wide per-head matrices match independent Gram inverse-square-root formulas.
Each full-row-rank head has orthonormal rows, invariant to its own positive scale.
Null singular directions and entire zero heads must not invent an update.
Permuting heads and rotating the input basis commute with per-head projection.
The functional core retains a correct local derivative away from repeated singular values and rank boundaries.
Student outputs retain equal head norms across six orders of magnitude of input scale.

provenance.adaptation: Synthetic two-head scale sweep with exact partial polar factors; not a GLM training benchmark or production Muon implementation.
